battle.name: 奈及利亞內戰
battle.theater: 尼日爾河三角洲與比夫拉海岸線
battle.brief: 1967年7月6日聯邦軍自阿薩巴強渡尼日爾河，比夫拉軍在恩古與加爾凱姆抵抗；聯邦海軍隨即沿比夫拉海岸線實施長達兩年半的封鎖，旗艦NNS Ogoja以三吋砲壓制改裝砲艇。卡面1862年英國鐵甲艦未參戰，但它確立的裝甲換砲邏輯，正是本役海戰繞著火炮與航速打轉的源頭。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 1967年至1970年的奈及利亞內戰，交戰雙方是拉各斯的聯邦軍方政府與宣佈獨立的比夫拉共和國。聯邦方面由雅卡博·戈翁中將主持軍政府，陸軍在1967年夏季只有七千人、無一輛坦克，到1969年春膨脹為約二十萬人，編為第一、第二、第三步兵師；海軍在1964年《海軍法》生效後肩負「奈及利亞的海上防禦」，開戰時僅有六艘船，最大的一艘是荷蘭建造的護衛艦NNS Nigeria，因吃水太深無法駛入尼日爾河三角洲的河道，實際作戰交由NNS Ogoja一類內河艦艇與海軍陸戰隊承擔。比夫拉方面，總統丘克維梅卡·奧朱古於1967年5月30日宣佈東部地區獨立，陸軍自恩古的兩百三十人起家，到1969年編成五個缺編師，另有德國傭兵羅夫·施泰納指揮的第四突擊旅；其海軍由溫妮弗雷德·阿努庫在哈科特港的腎臟島統率，兵力只有改裝拖船、武裝民船與改裝成砲艇的Chris-Craft快艇。外國方面，英國在聯邦攻下博尼島後轉向支持拉各斯，法國以象牙海岸與加蓬為管道暗中供給比夫拉武器與傭兵，蘇聯與以色列向聯邦、以色列與葡萄牙向比夫拉出售軍火，非洲統一組織則依章程反對會員國分裂，譴責比夫拉的行動。
countriesEn: The Nigerian Civil War of 1967 to 1970 was fought between the Federal Military Government in Lagos and the secessionist Republic of Biafra. On the federal side, General Yakubu Gowon headed the military government; the army numbered only 7,000 men without a single tank in the summer of 1967 and had swollen to some 200,000 by the spring of 1969, organised as the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Infantry Divisions. After the Navy Act of 1964 the navy was charged with the naval defence of Nigeria, but at the outbreak of war it possessed only six vessels, the largest being the Dutch-built frigate NNS Nigeria, which was too deep in draught to work the creeks of the Niger Delta; the actual fighting was carried by riverine craft such as NNS Ogoja and by marine infantry. On the Biafran side, President Chukwuemeka Odumegwu Ojukwu declared the Eastern Region independent on 30 May 1967; the army grew from 230 men at Enugu into five undermanned divisions by 1969, and there was also the 4th Commando Brigade under the German mercenary Rolf Steiner. The Biafran Navy, commanded by Winifred Anuku from a headquarters on Kidney Island at Port Harcourt, consisted of converted tugs, armed civil craft and Chris-Craft speedboats converted into gunboats. Among the foreign powers, Britain turned to back Lagos after the fall of Bonny, France supplied Biafra with weapons and mercenaries covertly through Ivory Coast and Gabon, the Soviet Union and Israel sold arms to the federal government while Israel and Portugal sold to Biafra, and the Organisation of African Unity, bound by its charter to oppose secession by a member state, condemned Biafra.
people: 聯邦一方的關鍵人物是軍政府首腦雅卡博·戈翁中將，他以「警察行動」名義在1967年7月6日發動攻擊，之後宣布全面戰爭，並在1969年12月23日與1970年1月7日兩度批准最後攻勢。前線指揮官中，舒瓦上校率第一師自北方進攻，姆塔拉·穆罕默德中校編成第二師從西線反擊，本·阿德庫恩萊上校以拉各斯守備部隊組成第三師並在三角洲叢林與河道中苦戰，奧巴桑喬上校後來接手該師並指揮最終攻勢。海軍方面，海軍少校阿金圖德·阿杜沃在1967年7月26日率NNS Ogoja參與博尼登陸，海軍司令由英籍後備軍官系統出身，海軍本身是英國式的產物。英方的高級專員大衛·亨特向哈拉米德首相提供判斷，促成英國在8月初轉向支持聯邦；法國方面，總統府非洲事務協調人讓·福卡爾與武器商皮埃爾·洛雷斯在背後調度軍援，比夫拉則由奧朱古、菲利普·埃菲翁與阿爾弗雷德·馬迪博等人主持戰爭委員會，埃菲翁後來在奧朱古出逃後代表比夫拉簽署投降書。傭兵方面，德國人羅夫·施泰納率第四突擊旅三千人並建立棕水海軍，瑞典人卡爾·古斯塔夫·馮·羅森駕駛Malmö MFI-9螺旋槳機攻擊聯邦機場，加拿大人林恩·加里森與波蘭-瑞士籍飛行員揚·曾巴赫先後駕機參戰。
peopleEn: The decisive personality on the federal side was General Yakubu Gowon, who launched the attack in the name of a police action on 6 July 1967, declared total war afterwards, and authorised the last offensives on 23 December 1969 and 7 January 1970. Among the field commanders, Colonel Mohammed Shuwa led the 1st Division in the northern thrust, Colonel Murtala Mohammed formed the 2nd Division for the counter-stroke from the west, and Colonel Benjamin Adekunle raised the 3rd Division out of the Lagos garrison and fought hard through the delta creeks and mangrove swamps, his command later passing to Colonel Olusegun Obasanjo, who directed the final offensive. On the naval side, Lieutenant Commander Akintunde Aduwo took NNS Ogoja in on the landing at Bonny on 26 July 1967, and the navy itself was a British product built around a reserve-officer cadre. On the British side the High Commissioner David Hunt briefed Prime Minister Harold Wilson and helped turn British support toward the federal side in early August; on the French side Jean Foccart, the President's coordinator for African affairs, and the arms dealer Pierre Laureys arranged the covert deliveries to Biafra. Biafra's war cabinet was headed by Ojukwu together with Philip Effiong and Alexander Madiebo, and Effiong later signed the surrender on behalf of Biafra after Ojukwu had fled. Among the mercenaries, the German Rolf Steiner commanded the 3,000 men of the 4th Commando Brigade and built the brown-water navy, the Swede Carl Gustaf von Rosen flew Malmö MFI-9 piston-engined aircraft against federal airfields, and the Canadian Lynn Garrison and the Polish-Swiss pilot Jan Zumbach both flew for Biafra.
kits: 卡面那艘1862年的英國鐵甲艦本身沒有出現在1967年的戰場，但同年發生的鐵甲艦首次主力對決，正是海軍設計邏輯的分水嶺：裝甲第一次比火砲更難對付，砲位隨後全部繞著裝甲帶佈置。本役海戰延續的卻是同一條路線的縮小版。聯邦海軍的作戰骨幹是NNS Ogoja，原為美國二戰時期PC-461級護衛驅逐艦，經荷蘭轉交奈及利亞，改裝後排水量約四百五十噸，全長約一百七十三呎八吋，最大航速二十點二節，編制六十五人，前部一門三吋五〇倍徑主砲，尾部一門三吋五〇或40公厘波福斯砲，另有二十公厘機砲、深水炸藥投射器與投放軌，續航三千海里。她吃水淺、能在沼澤水道中轉向，正是能深入博尼河口的那種船；同期最大的護衛艦NNS Nigeria反而因吃水太深留在外海。比夫拉一方則走相反極端，沒有裝甲可言：改裝拖船、加固的民用船殼、配備機槍或擄獲六磅砲，另有由Chris-Craft快艇改裝的砲艇。陸戰裝備方面，聯邦得到法國出售的潘哈德輕裝甲車與以色列交付的迫擊炮彈，比夫拉得到法國提供的兩架A-26攻擊機與Alouette II直升機、以及一批二戰德意武器，聯邦空軍則有六架IL-28轟炸機與MiG-17戰鬥機。
kitsEn: The British ironclad of 1862 on the card never appeared on the 1967 battlefield, but the first clash between ironclads fought in that same year marked the watershed in naval design: armour for the first time proved harder to defeat than guns, and the gun positions were thereafter all laid out around the armour belt. The naval fighting of this war continued a shrunken version of that same line. The backbone of the federal navy was NNS Ogoja, an American Second World War PC-461-class submarine chaser transferred through the Netherlands to Nigeria and converted, with a displacement of about 450 tons, a length of some 173 feet 8 inches, a maximum speed of 20.2 knots and a complement of 65, carrying a 3-inch 50 calibre gun forward, a 3-inch 50 or 40mm Bofors gun aft, 20mm cannon, K-gun depth charge projectors and depth charge rails, with a range of 3,000 nautical miles. Her shallow draught let her turn in the swamp channels, which made her the sort of ship that could push up the Bonny River; the much larger frigate NNS Nigeria, by contrast, stayed outside because she drew too much. Biafra went to the opposite extreme, with no armour at all: converted tugs, civilian hulls reinforced with plating, armed with machine guns or captured 6-pounder guns, and Chris-Craft speedboats converted into gunboats. On land the federal government received Panhard light armoured cars from France and mortar rounds from Israel, while Biafra received two A-26 attack aircraft and Alouette II helicopters from France together with captured German and Italian weapons of the Second World War; the federal air force fielded six IL-28 bombers and MiG-17 fighters.
tactics: 聯邦的戰術是三路併進：地面沿公路縱深推進、以砲兵與空軍支援，海上以宣布封鎖配合攔截，內河則用小艇隊逐段掃清水道。1967年7月6日以代號UNICORD的行動分兩縱隊渡過尼日爾河，東西兩路分別指向恩古與加爾凱姆，7月12日取加爾凱姆、7月14日取恩古北面的恩蘇卡。7月26日，NNS Ogoja率九艘海軍艦艇與兩艘商船在博尼河口登陸，砲擊岸上比夫拉目標；比夫拉唯一海軍艇BNS Vigilance的前身是英國海軍Ford級海防艇，該艇40公厘波福斯砲連射三至四發即卡殼，機動時擱淺，被Ogoja的三吋砲擊中後棄船。10月17日至20日的虎爪行動中，Ogoja率小型艦隊在卡拉巴爾登陸並以艦砲支援陸軍。1968年3月進攻哈科特港的最後一天，Ogoja被比夫拉布設的遙控水雷炸傷，港區仍於5月19日淪陷。比夫拉的戰術是守點與襲擊並用：在阿巴加納、阿羅丘克武、奧古塔、烏穆阿希亞等地以伏擊拖住聯邦推進，1969年3月第十四師一度收復奧韋里、5月奪回夸萊油井，同時以棕水海軍的Chris-Craft砲艇突破封鎖線搶運軍火，最終攻勢則由第三海軍陸戰師在1970年1月7日的順風行動中發動。
tacticsEn: Federal operations ran on three axes at once: an advance in depth along the roads supported by artillery and aircraft, a blockade enforced by proclamation and interception at sea, and a step-by-step clearing of the waterways by small boat groups inland. On 6 July 1967 the operation code-named UNICORD crossed the River Niger in two columns, the western and eastern columns driving towards Enugu and Garkem; Garkem fell on 12 July and Nsukka, north of Enugu, on 14 July. On 26 July NNS Ogoja landed troops at the mouth of the Bonny River with a fleet of nine Nigerian Navy ships and two merchant ships and shelled Biafran positions ashore. The only Biafran naval vessel, BNS Vigilance, was a former Royal Navy Ford-class seaward defence boat whose 40mm Bofors gun jammed after three or four rounds; she ran aground while manoeuvring and was struck by Ogoja's 3-inch gun, her crew abandoning ship. During Operation Tiger Claw from 17 to 20 October Ogoja led a small flotilla that landed troops at Calabar and gave naval gunfire support to the army. On the last day of March 1968, during the attack on Port Harcourt, Ogoja was damaged by a Biafran remote-controlled mine, but the port itself fell on 19 May. Biafran tactics combined holding ground with raiding: ambushes at Abagana, Arochukwu, Oguta and Umuahia slowed the federal advance, the 14th Division retook Owerri in March 1969 and the Kwale oil wells in May, and Chris-Craft gunboats of the brown-water navy broke through the blockade to run arms in. The final federal move was Operation Tail-Wind, launched by the 3rd Marine Commando Division on 7 January 1970.
data: 時間跨度：1967年7月6日開火，至1970年1月15日聯邦軍完全控制比夫拉殘餘地區，前後約兩年半，最後攻勢在1月7日展開，奧韋里1月9日淪陷、烏利1月11日淪陷，投降文件1月14日在拉各斯簽署。兵力：聯邦陸軍由1967年夏的七千人增至1969年春約二十萬人，編三個師；比夫拉軍由恩古的兩百三十人起步，1967年8月已是兩個營並擴充為第五十一、第五十二旅，1968年整編為十一萬人的「政治軍」，1969年實際編成五個缺編師共約九萬人。聯邦海軍開戰時只有六艘船，最大的是護衛艦；空軍七十六架飛機，無一架戰鬥機或轟炸機。封鎖：沿比夫拉海岸線宣布封鎖約二百英里，維持兩年半，有兩艘突破封鎖的船被奈及利亞海軍擊毀。艦艇數據：NNS Ogoja排水約四百五十噸、長一百七十三呎八吋、航速二十點二節、編制六十五人；1967年7月26日博尼登陸投入九艘海軍艦艇與兩艘商船。石油：博尼油輪碼頭因航道淤積，單船容量由七萬噸降至約四萬噸；新建的福爾卡多斯終端與管線歷時十八個月，1969年中完工；全國產量由1958年的日產十四萬二千桶升至1969年的五十四萬桶，1970年再翻倍至每日一百零八萬桶。博尼島7月25日易手，哈科特港1968年5月19日淪陷，Ogoja於1969年10月25日在阿卡薩燈塔外海約兩英里處擱淺而除籍。
dataEn: Duration: the war opened on 6 July 1967 and ended with the federal army in complete control of the remaining Biafran territory on 15 January 1970, some two and a half years in all; the last offensive opened on 7 January, Owerri fell on 9 January and Uli on 11 January, and the surrender document was signed in Lagos on 14 January. Manpower: the federal army grew from 7,000 men in the summer of 1967 to about 200,000 by the spring of 1969, organised in three divisions. Biafra started with 230 men at Enugu, had two battalions by August 1967 which expanded into the 51st and 52nd Brigades, was reorganised in 1968 into a political army of 110,000, and by 1969 actually fielded five undermanned divisions totalling some 90,000 men. The federal navy had only six vessels at the outbreak, the largest a frigate, and the air force had seventy-six aircraft, not one of which was a fighter or a bomber. The blockade: a blockade of roughly 200 miles of the Biafran coastline was proclaimed and maintained for two and a half years, and two ships attempting to run it were destroyed by the Nigerian Navy. Ship data: NNS Ogoja displaced about 450 tons, was 173 feet 8 inches long, made 20.2 knots and carried 65 men; the landing at Bonny on 26 July 1967 committed nine Nigerian Navy ships and two merchant ships. Oil: silting of the approaches to the Bonny terminal cut the capacity of a single tanker from 70,000 tons to about 40,000 tons; the new Forcados terminal and its pipeline took eighteen months to build and were completed in the middle of 1969; national output rose from 142,000 barrels a day in 1958 to 540,000 in 1969 and doubled again to 1.08 million a day in 1970. Bonny Island changed hands on 25 July, Port Harcourt fell on 19 May 1968, and Ogoja ran aground and was struck off the list about two miles off the Akassa lighthouse on 25 October 1969.
cause: 戰爭的直接起因是1966年的兩次政變與聯邦內部的族群與地區失衡。1966年1月15日一批少壯軍官推翻政府、殺害北部政要，5月29日反政變清洗伊博族軍官後，聯邦軍政府於5月24日以第34號統一法令取消四區分治，北方因而認定聯邦正走向伊博統治。1967年5月27日，戈翁把全國重劃為十二個州，把伊博人佔多數的東部切成南東、河流與東中三州，主要油田所在的產油區被劃出伊博核心之外，石油收益的歸屬從此成為生死問題。5月30日奧朱古宣佈比夫拉獨立，聯邦軍政府隨即對其實施全面航運禁運，初期只禁一般船舶、不禁油輪；6月底殼牌石油向比夫拉支付二十五萬英鎊特許權費之後，聯邦把禁運擴展到油輪，等於切斷比夫拉唯一的現金來源。戰爭在1967年7月6日凌晨打開，聯邦以「警察行動」為名發動攻擊，戰事全面爆發。國際層面上，法國延續對加丹加分裂主義的介入路線，比夫拉向法國、葡萄牙與捷克斯洛伐克求援，蘇聯與以色列則支援拉各斯，而非洲統一組織按章程站在維護領土完整的一邊。
causeEn: The immediate causes were the two coups of 1966 and the ethnic and regional imbalance inside the federation. On 15 January 1966 a group of young officers overthrew the government and killed its northern leaders; after the counter-coup of 29 May purged the Igbo officers, the federal military government abolished the four regions with Unification Decree Number 34 on 24 May, and the north read the change as a slide towards Igbo domination. On 27 May 1967 Gowon divided the country into twelve states, cutting the Igbo-majority Eastern Region into the South-Eastern, Rivers and East Central states and thereby cutting the main oil-producing area away from the Igbo core; who received the oil revenue was now the question of life and death. On 30 May Ojukwu declared the Republic of Biafra, and the federal military government immediately imposed a shipping embargo on it, at first covering ordinary shipping but not the tankers. When Shell-BP paid Biafra 250,000 pounds in royalties at the end of June, the embargo was extended to the tankers as well, cutting off Biafra's only source of foreign currency. The war opened in the early hours of 6 July 1967 with the federal attack launched in the name of a police action, and the crisis became a full-scale war. At the international level France carried on the interventionist line it had taken with Katanga, while Biafra turned to France, Portugal and Czechoslovakia for arms and the Soviet Union and Israel supported Lagos, and the Organisation of African Unity, by its own charter, stood on the side of territorial integrity.
impact: 這場戰爭同時改變了奈及利亞的國家形式與軍隊形態，並留下直到今日仍未結算的政治賬。聯邦勝利保住了國家的統一，卻把伊博族問題擱置：比夫拉作為分離主義的符號，此後數十年仍被海外伊博社群與國內部分政治力量援引，而聯邦軍隊在東部留下的常駐力量，使得東部的政治空間長期收窄。經濟上，這是奈及利亞石油國家的起點，產量在戰後兩年內由每日五十四萬桶升破一百萬桶，海軍與陸軍的現代化經費正來自這條收入線，聯邦軍方在1970年代後的權力膨脹亦與此有關。軍事上，奈及利亞海軍第一次以作戰分隊的姿態出戰，確立了以內河艦艇與封鎖執法為核心的三角洲防衛路線，比夫拉的棕水海軍以Chris-Craft快艇偷渡軍火的做法，也留下海上走私與小型快速艇的影子，而1968年聯邦軍在三角洲大量使用海軍陸戰與艦砲支援，成為後來幾內亞灣反海盜行動的源頭。國際法層面上，以宣布封鎖斷絕進口作為戰爭手段的做法在當時尚未被禁止，卻在此後備受爭議，非洲統一組織的反分裂立場也由此獲得案例。
impactEn: The war changed both the form of the Nigerian state and the shape of its armed forces, and it left a political account that is still unsettled. Federal victory preserved the unity of the country but set the Igbo question aside: Biafra remained a symbol of secession for decades afterwards, invoked by Igbo communities abroad and by parts of the domestic polity, while the permanent federal military presence in the east narrowed the political space available to the eastern region for a long time. Economically this was the beginning of Nigeria as an oil state, with output passing a million barrels a day within two years of the fighting, and the money that paid for the modernisation of navy and army came from that revenue line; the growing political weight of the military after 1970 grew out of it as well. Militarily the Nigerian Navy fought its first war as an organised fighting force, fixing a delta defence doctrine built on riverine craft and the enforcement of blockades, while Biafra's practice of running arms in by Chris-Craft boats left a trace in later patterns of maritime smuggling and small fast craft; the federal army's heavy use of marines and naval gunfire in the delta in 1968 became a forerunner of later Gulf of Guinea counter-piracy operations. On the international law front, using a proclaimed blockade to cut off imports as a method of war was not yet prohibited at the time, but it became deeply contested afterwards, and the African Unity position on secession acquired its working example here.
result: 聯邦軍在1970年1月的順風行動中給出結局。第三海軍陸戰師自奧巴桑喬指揮，1月7日發動攻擊，北方第一師、南面第二師夾擊，1月9日奧韋里淪陷、1月11日烏利淪陷，比夫拉控制的東部被切成兩段，聯邦軍隊在零星抵抗下推進至殘餘地區。比夫拉在恩古的指揮部於1967年10月4日已隨聯邦軍攻入而崩潰，奧朱古先退往烏穆阿希亞，1970年1月初飛往象牙海岸流亡，副手菲利普·埃菲翁於1月13日向戈翁投降，文件1月14日在拉各斯簽署，戰事於1月15日結束，比夫拉作為國家實體消失，東部三州重新併入聯邦行政與聯邦軍管制之下。海軍方面，NNS Nigeria 仍在外海待命，Ogoja 於1969年10月擱淺除籍後內河艦隊縮減，比夫拉殘餘的 Chris-Craft 砲艇被繳獲。石油一端，比夫拉時期失去博尼與哈科特港的聯邦軍重新控制全部出口設施，福爾卡多斯新終端承擔了主要外運任務，聯邦以封鎖作為終局手段的做法亦在此役中得到完整示範。
resultEn: The outcome was delivered by the federal army in the Operation Tail-Wind offensive of January 1970. The 3rd Marine Commando Division under Obasanjo attacked on 7 January, the 1st Infantry Division on the northern flank and the 2nd on the southern one, Owerri fell on 9 January and Uli on 11 January, and the Biafran-held east was cut in two, the federal forces advancing through scattered resistance into the remaining areas. The Biafran command at Enugu had already collapsed when federal troops entered the city on 4 October 1967; Ojukwu withdrew to Umuahia and in early January 1970 flew into exile in Ivory Coast, while his deputy Philip Effiong surrendered to Gowon on 13 January and the documents were signed in Lagos on 14 January, the fighting ending on 15 January. The Republic of Biafra disappeared as a state, and the three eastern states were folded back into federal administration and federal military control. On the naval side NNS Nigeria stood off outside the delta and, with Ogoja run aground and struck off the list in October 1969, the riverine force was reduced, the surviving Chris-Craft gunboats being captured. On the oil side, the federal army, which had held Bonny and Port Harcourt through most of the war, took control of all export facilities, and the new Forcados terminal carried the main burden of shipments; the federal practice of using the blockade as the finishing move was thus given its complete demonstration in this war.
